about.title: About Nabd
about.subtitle: Nabd is your smart guide to discovering the best AI tools that will change how you work and create.
about.mission_desc: Making AI tool discovery easy for Arabic users with a comprehensive, up-to-date directory.
about.who_desc: For creators, entrepreneurs, developers, writers, designers, and anyone looking to boost productivity.
about.why_desc: We provide accurate categorization, real reviews, and up-to-date information on the latest AI tools.
about.story_p1: Nabd started as a simple idea: provide one place that gathers the best AI tools for Arabic users.
about.story_p2: With AI tools spreading rapidly, it became difficult to keep up with every new release. That's where Nabd comes in — we research and evaluate on your behalf.
about.story_p3: We believe AI should be accessible to everyone, and we strive to provide high-quality Arabic content to help you make informed decisions.
about.cta: Ready to explore the tools of the future?

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about Nabd and AI tools.
faq.not_found: Didn't find what you were looking for?
faq.meta_desc: Answers to common questions about Nabd AI and AI tools directory. Learn how to use the site and choose the right tools.
faq.meta_keywords: faq, nabd, ai directory, help, frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Nabd is a comprehensive Arabic guide to the best AI tools. We help you discover the right tools for your work and creativity through clear categories and real reviews.
faq.a2: Tools vary in pricing. Some are completely free, some are paid, and others offer a limited free version with paid options for advanced features. We clarify the pricing type for each tool in our guide.
faq.q3: How do I choose the right AI tool for me?
faq.a3: Identify your need first (text, images, video, coding, productivity), then use the categories filter on our site. Read the tool description and user reviews to make an informed decision.
faq.q4: Can I add a new tool to the directory?
faq.a4: Yes! You can suggest a new tool using the 'Add Tool' button on the home page. The tool will be reviewed before being added to the directory.
faq.a5: Registered users can rate tools from 1 to 5 stars and write reviews. We show the average rating and number of reviews for each tool.
faq.a6: We categorize tools into: Text (ChatGPT, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude 3.5), Images (Midjourney, DALL-E), Video (Sora, Runway), Coding (GitHub Copilot), and Productivity (Notion AI, Jasper).
faq.q7: Is the site available as an app?
faq.a7: Yes! Nabd is a Progressive Web App (PWA). You can install it on your phone or device from the installation page for quick access and offline use.
faq.q8: How do I contact the Nabd team?
faq.a8: You can contact us via the 'Contact Us' page or send an email to contact@amiraq.org. We are happy to answer your inquiries and suggestions.
